quarterly_data.signal: Tenstorrent Cloud is serving the open-weights MiniMax M3.1 Flash model from its release day on a supercluster of Tenstorrent Blackhole Galaxy systems, with prefill and decode both running on Galaxy (split onto separate systems); each Blackhole Galaxy has 1 TB of DRAM and several terabytes of SSD for KV-cache offload. The model is available on console.tenstorrent.com.
